content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments represent a decentralized solution for selling digital products, bypassing restrictions imposed by traditional payment gateways. By utilizing the Solana blockchain, creators can leverage cryptocurrency for transactions, ensuring fast and low-cost payment processing. This system not only reduces dependence on platforms that charge high fees but also empowers creators with full ownership of their sales data and infrastructure. Understanding this framework can drastically change how you approach selling digital goods.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for Solana payments is built around several key components: a hosting solution, backend logic, a database for orders, and an automatic payment processor. For example, using GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing creates a seamless transaction environment. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can manage backend logic efficiently, while a solution like Supabase stores your orders. This combination ensures that transactions are processed quickly and securely, with minimal fees compared to traditional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. If you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, using Solana payments can significantly reduce costs and enhance your revenue. This setup is ideal for anyone looking to bypass high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, compared to NOWPayments' mere 0.5% fee.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, saving you money compared to traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of Solana payments lies in its components working in harmony. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as your hosting platform, while backend processing is handled by either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. For order storage, you can utilize Supabase or even Google Sheets, ensuring a cost-effective and scalable solution. NOWPayments ties everything together by enabling automatic cryptocurrency payment processing, making the entire system efficient and user-friendly for both creators and buyers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own infrastructure for selling digital products using Solana payments, start by selecting a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring you have logic in place to process orders. Utilize Supabase for storing order data and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. Finally, upload your products for sale and begin marketing your digital goods to your audience, taking full control of your sales process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Complete ownership of your infrastructure means you're not at the mercy of third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to establish your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
